waktu.label: Idle technician time
waktu.why: Technicians get paid to wait for the schedule, the customer or materials.
waktu.fix: Group jobs by zone, set 2-hour slots and fill gaps with small jobs.

perjalanan.label: Travel & fuel
perjalanan.why: Unordered routes send the crew back and forth, burning fuel and work hours.
perjalanan.fix: Order visits by zone, assign the nearest crew and avoid cross-city schedules.

bahan.label: Materials & consumables
bahan.why: Overdosing, wasted packaging and leftover materials.
bahan.fix: Measure per job, log leftovers per technician and reorder based on real usage.

pengerjaan_ulang.label: Rework & callbacks
pengerjaan_ulang.why: Inconsistent quality forces unpaid second visits.
pengerjaan_ulang.fix: A checklist before leaving the site, photos of the result and a customer signature.

air_kimia.label: Water & chemicals
air_kimia.why: Mixing without measuring and over-rinsing waste water and chemicals.
air_kimia.fix: Use measuring tools and dosing tablets, and recycle rinse water on heavy jobs.

hero.text: Of the {loss} in losses you have logged, {saved} has been stopped. The remaining {remaining} equals {share}.
hero.noCompare: — no recorded revenue to compare against
hero.empty: No losses logged yet. Log a first finding so the 100% waste-free target has an honest starting point.

plan.title: Shortest path to zero
plan.clean: Every stream is clean. Keep it that way with a monthly check.

list.emptyTitle: Start with the leak you feel most
list.emptyBody: For example: technicians wait 45 minutes for materials per job, or a return visit because a stain stayed. Every finding needs a monthly loss figure.
list.noMatch: No matching findings. Change the search or filters.

rework.label: Stop return visits
rework.problem: Rework and callbacks cost money. I want to push this to zero without slowing the crew down.

route.label: Tidy routes & fuel
route.problem: Travel costs are up because schedules are not ordered. I want to save the fuel and work hours lost on the road.

zero.label: 100% waste-free target
zero.problem: I want to close every recorded leak and reach zero monthly loss within three months.

editor.streamHint: Pick one source so reports stay separate.
editor.title: What's leaking
editor.titlePlaceholder: Example: Technicians wait for materials at the warehouse
editor.lossHint: An honest estimate is more useful than a number that looks good.
editor.savedHint: Enter zero if nothing has been done yet.
editor.actionPlaceholder: What will be or has been done.
editor.description: One finding = one leak with a number and an owner. That is what makes the 100% target measurable.
editor.lossRequired: Monthly loss must be more than zero.
editor.savedTooHigh: The stopped amount cannot exceed the recorded loss.

markDone.done: Finding closed; the loss now counts as stopped.

delete.title: Delete this finding?
delete.description: "{title}" will be deleted and no longer count toward the waste-free target.

bulk.label: Paste data
bulk.hint: A JSON array, or one line per finding: source | title | loss | stopped | owner | status. Sources: waktu, perjalanan, bahan, pengerjaan_ulang, air_kimia.
bulk.placeholder:
perjalanan | Unordered routes between districts | 900000 | 0 | Operations team | open
bahan | Too much chemical in small pools | 400000 | 150000 | Operations team | progress
bulk.skip: Skip findings whose title already exists
bulk.title: Bulk import findings
bulk.description: Paste from a spreadsheet. If one row is invalid the whole import is rejected, so the totals are never half-done.
bulk.allDupes: Every finding already exists. Nothing was imported.

parse.empty: There is no data to import.
parse.badJson: Invalid JSON. Check commas and quotes.
parse.notArray: The JSON must be a list of findings.
